title: Saga 2 Chapter 28 — New Year New You / Nuru
summary: The first 2015 recording combines the show's most explicit internal product review with a long Japan/soapland account and a late Kamui Kobayashi interview. New headsets and close microphones are tested because David calls prior Saga 2 audio unlistenable, Asa says the show lacks structure and producing, and the group proposes rotating producers before immediately admitting weak follow-through. Those direct remarks establish the archive's need for synchronized source playback, corrected reader text, speaker/evidence states, exact topic entry and exit, and separate recording/release dates. The episode then demonstrates why flat transcripts fail: live studio dialogue shifts into recollection, reenactment, disputed memory, recorded sexual audio, non-native-English guest testimony, trivia and Mangchi lyrics. All explicit speech remains uncensored. Anonymous workers, private messages, recorded voices, screenshots, minors and absent partners remain outside discovery; paid services do not imply consent to recording, identification or every act. Medical, legal, racial, national and causal claims are contextualized separately rather than rewritten.

speaker_policy.reason: Participants and guests are often explicit in context, but this artifact has no validated named turns or held-out identity windows. Non-native-English grammar and overlapping studio speech make acoustic validation essential before line-level publication.

source_notes.claim: Pornography explains sexual conduct among children and teacher/student cases.
source_notes.assessment: The episode offers anecdotes, not causal evidence. Sexual activity involving children may constitute abuse and cannot be normalized as a pornography scenario.

source_notes.claim: Men are inherently predators and any man will have sex with any woman.
source_notes.assessment: These are broad speaker generalizations, not evidence-based universal facts and never a substitute for individual consent.
This is a self-label immediately disputed by another participant. The recording is not diagnostic evidence.

source_notes.claim: Ass-to-mouth contact is only a pink-eye joke.
source_notes.assessment: Fecal-oral and mucous-membrane exposure can transmit infection; hygiene and barrier practices matter.

source_notes.claim: Nuru gel is universally natural, good for the body and safe vaginally, anally and orally.
source_notes.assessment: Composition varies by product. Follow label directions, check condom compatibility and allergies, and treat the extremely slippery surface as a fall hazard.

source_notes.claim: Teenagers are sent to armies because their brains are undeveloped and they believe they are indestructible.
source_notes.assessment: Adolescent brain development continues into young adulthood, but the military explanation is an unsupported simplification.
